title: ELAC 6.5" Contractor In-Ceiling Speaker [Each] $39 + Delivery (free delivery $100+ spend) @ Addicted to Audio
body:
Deal: ELAC 6.5" Contractor In-Ceiling Speaker [Each] $39 + Delivery (free delivery $100+ spend) @ Addicted to Audio

[Whilezee] Firsly, I'm no audiophone so someone else will need to confirm. But from my understanding you need to run cables back to something like a Unifi PowerAmp or a AV Receiver.
I'm going to try play around and see how they sound on an entry level Yamaha 5.1 setup too. May replace the rear two with these if they don't clash with the sound from the fronts.
If you are looking to do the same just need to make sure the impedance is compatible.
Again, take my comments with a dose of salt as I'm still new to this stuff. Hence looking for cheaper stuff to tinker with.
[lilviss] Cool
I'm very tempted to do this. Keen to hear how you go
[Big L] https://addictedtoaudio.com.au/collections/over-ear-headphon…
Gives you an idea on how much they mark-up.
There's tons of copies of these on the market.
[Whilezee] When you add 4 to their cart and see
Total
$156.00
You saved $1,240.00!
It does make me wonder the same..
[Big L] There's plenty of places charging similar high amounts as well. I have no idea what they're really worth, but at least this place has physical locations to give a vague peace of mind that it's not a knockoff.
[Whilezee] I did walk past their shop the other week in Melbourne. Looked super fancy.
[Matt P] Elac generally are a solid brand. You could always install into a large box to test first (usual install is wall/roof so infinite baffle but a large box shouldn't be drastically different.
[trippy] I am thinking you have to be pretty sure you will like the sound before you start cutting holes in your ceiling. Is it really a good idea to go for the cheapest speakers? But I guess Elac makes some pretty good bookshelf speakers.
[Whilezee] To be fair, if their 'normal price' is correct, these are $349 each.
So they aren't necessarily cheap speakers, they are just heavily discounted..
At least that's what I told myself when I bought some, haha.
